description: Microprocessor Brix transmitter, conventional and self-cleaning: XS and RS channel volts and Brix, current channel, alarms, relays, retransmission, linearisation tables and calibration
source: DLG SD-3000 user manual MAN-PT-DE-SD3000-01.00_17 (Portuguese), Modbus table

sources.title: Transmissor de Brix Microprocessado SD-3000 – Manual do usuário
sources.note: linked in issue #446; Modbus table, bit masks and register values

notes: Modbus RTU over RS485, two serial channels. Defaults: address 1, 19200 baud, no parity.
The manual lists the registers as 40001 on with an offset column from 0; the map uses the offset, as sent on the wire. US is unsigned and SS signed 16-bit.

On the conventional Brix transmitter registers 40001, 40008, 40010 and 40042 are reserved, 40029 is the alarm 2 delay and 40033 the alarm 2 setpoint; the self-cleaning model uses them for the cleaning cycle.
The manual does not give the scaling of the volts, Brix and temperature values.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Time left until cleaning
registers.description: Self-cleaning model; reserved on the conventional model.

registers.name: Current channel
registers.description: Engineering value, -30000 to 30000, with the decimal places in 40025.

registers.name: Freeze time left
registers.description: Self-cleaning model; reserved on the conventional model.

registers.name: Cleaning time left
registers.description: Self-cleaning model; reserved on the conventional model.

registers.name: Relay set and reset
registers.description: 1 releases relay 1, 2 releases relay 2, 4 operates relay 1, 8 operates relay 2 (add to combine; reset wins over set). Only for relays not assigned to an alarm.

registers.name: Modbus address
registers.description: 1 to 255, default 1. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: Channel 1 parity
registers.description: Default none. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: Channel 1 timeout
registers.description: 10 to 100, default 10. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: Channel 2 parity
registers.description: Default none. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: Channel 2 timeout
registers.description: 10 to 100, default 10. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: Current channel engineering high
registers.description: -30000 to 30000, default 20000. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: Current channel decimal point
registers.description: 0 to 4 decimal places, default 3. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: Alarm control
registers.description: Low nibble: alarm 1 channel (0 off, 1 XS, 2 RS, 3 XS linearised, 4 RS linearised, 5 current). High nibble: alarm 2 channel (0x10 to 0x50, same order) on the conventional model, or relay 2 cleaning mode (0x10 off, 0x20 automatic, 0x30 manual) on the self-cleaning model. Add the two. Default 0x25. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: Alarm condition
registers.description: Alarm 1: 0 minimum, 1 maximum, 2 differential, 3 inverted differential, 4 inoperative. Alarm 2: 0, 8, 16, 24, 32 in the same order. Add the two. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: Alarm 2 delay or cleaning interval
registers.description: Alarm 2 delay on the conventional model; time between cleanings on the self-cleaning model. 0 to 1440. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: Alarm 2 setpoint or cleaning injection time
registers.description: Alarm 2 setpoint on the conventional model; cleaning injection time (0 to 600) on the self-cleaning model. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: Retransmission type
registers.description: Low nibble for output 1, high nibble for output 2: 0 is 0-20 mA or 0-10 V on the engineering range, 1 is 0-20 mA or 0-10 V on the retransmission limits, 2 is 4-20 mA or 2-10 V on the engineering range, 3 is 4-20 mA or 2-10 V on the retransmission limits. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: Retransmitted channel
registers.description: Low nibble for output 1, high nibble for output 2: 0 off, 1 XS, 2 RS, 3 XS linearised, 4 RS linearised, 5 current. Default 0x55. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: XS and RS freeze time
registers.description: 0 to 6000. Self-cleaning model; reserved on the conventional model. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: XS control enabled
registers.description: 0 enables the XS control, 1 disables it.

registers.name: Mass type
registers.description: Password protected. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: XS target
registers.description: 0 to 15000. Password protected. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: DA1
registers.description: 0 to 1500, default 1000. Password protected. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: DA2
registers.description: 0 to 1500, default 0. Password protected. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: DA3
registers.description: 0 to 1500, default 937. Password protected. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: DA4
registers.description: 0 to 1500, default 600. Password protected. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: Lag filter
registers.description: 0 to 100, default 30. Password protected. Kept at power loss.

registers.name: Lag error
registers.description: 0 to 100, default 30. Password protected. Kept at power loss.
